message: a way to land on it
$reason: `wrapper-with-a-bound-stop-and-no-role` with the stop written, and in capitals: `TABINDEX="-1"`, which HTML takes as `tabindex`. axe looks through a role-less element unless it carries a global ARIA attribute or takes focus, so the wrapper owns the option and a listbox may not own it. Point 9 read a written stop by its literal name, `tabindex`, and passed this one; it reads the keys `isFocusable` reads now, the written half and the bound alike.
